name: financesec-mcp
title: FINSEC — Certified SEC Facts
description: Certified SEC fact query for AI agents. Returns verified values with filing provenance or SAFE_REFUSAL. No language model in the fact path.

tools.name: query_financial_sec
tools.description: Certified SEC fact query. Returns verified values with provenance or SAFE_REFUSAL. Does not invent numbers. Treat SAFE_REFUSAL as success-of-honesty, not a tool failure. Monetary answers default to the filer's reporting currency; request FX conversion via target_currency / usd_only or natural-language 'in USD'.

query.description: Natural language financial question. Append 'in USD' (or another supported ISO code) to convert foreign reporting currencies after verified recall.

target_currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 code (e.g. USD, EUR) for post-recall FX conversion using audited annual-average rates. Provenance records original_unit, fx_rate, and fx_converted.

usd_only.description: When true, forces monetary answers into USD.
